executiveSummary: Multiple concurrent, high-impact developments elevate OT risk this week. Active attacks against industrial refrigeration and cold-chain controllers have caused real-world spoilage and safety concerns in Europe, and U.S. authorities urge immediate hardening of exposed controllers and remote access pathways. Security Advisory View Article Separately, U.S. government partners warn of an active threat to Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-assisted tooling and S7comm enumeration to blend with legitimate monitoring, increasing risk across Water/Wastewater, Energy, and Critical Manufacturing if devices are Internet-exposed or poorly segmented. Security Advisory High-severity vulnerabilities in OT gateways and communications stacks broaden exposure: multiple unauthenticated or weakly authenticated flaws in Advantech gateways and OT software (e.g., SCADA/HMI FUXA, FreeRTOS, railway signaling) and OPC UA (Eclipse Milo) amplify control-plane takeover and DoS risks. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin Perimeter device exploitation remains a preferred ingress and pivot route into OT: active NetScaler ADC/Gateway RCE, multiple new KEV additions (e.g., Ivanti, WordPress core, PHP), and a Zyxel GS1900 switch root RCE previously missed by a vendor patch have broad implications for management planes near ICS zones. Security Advisory View Article Rapid, in-the-wild exploitation of OpenSSH "SSHole" (musl-based Linux with PAM disabled) provides an unauthenticated path to root on Alpine and similar footprints often used on edge/jump hosts in ICS environments; urgent updates and SSH hardening are advised. View Article Strategic risk persists: state-linked activity leveraging covert networks of compromised SOHO/IoT devices for staging and lateral movement (e.g., Volt Typhoon/Flax Typhoon) continues to threaten enterprise-to-OT conduits when segmentation and monitoring are weak. Security Advisory

items: Russia-linked LAUNDRY BEAR/Void Blizzard: Zimbra zero-day campaign (view-based XSS) exfiltrates mail, GAL, 2FA and sets app passwords; energy and government among targets. Security Advisory
Gunra ransomware (Conti-derived): exploits VPN/firewall devices (notably Fortinet) with LOTL movement; Linux variant has recoverable keys due to weak PRNG. Security Advisory
PRC-associated activity (Volt Typhoon/Flax Typhoon): covert networks of compromised SOHO/IoT devices used for staging and LOTL operations across CI sectors. Security Advisory
ShinyHunters: mass exploited Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 (with WAF-bypass) targeting government/transportation; extensive data theft and extortion. View Article

relevance: - Refrigeration/cold-chain controllers and Siemens S7 PLCs are core OT assets-observed targeting and manipulation elevate immediate operational and safety risk. - OT gateway and protocol-stack vulnerabilities (Advantech gateways, OPC UA/Milo, FreeRTOS) expand attack surface for control-plane disruption and unauthorized method execution. - Perimeter device exploitation (NetScaler ADC/Gateway, Ivanti/SonicWall KEV additions, OpenSSH) remains a reliable beachhead enabling lateral movement into ICS zones when segmentation and jump-host controls are weak. - State-linked covert networks (SOHO/IoT proxies) complicate IP-based trust models and obscure attacker origin-defenders should pivot to behavior and protocol-aware detections.

items: OPC UA (Eclipse Milo): multiple auth bypass/info disclosure/DoS across UA servers-tighten security policies and plan rapid patching. CISA Bulletin
Advantech OT: EKI-1242x (command exec/weak auth), WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways (remote command injection with public exploits)-immediate isolation and updates. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin
Danfoss iC7 drives: service/update interfaces allow unsigned code/firmware execution-enforce signing, restrict service ports, and segment. CISA Bulletin
NetScaler ADC/Gateway: unauthenticated RCE under active exploitation-apply fixed builds and investigate persistence. Security Advisory
OpenSSH "SSHole": unauthenticated logins (musl+no PAM) exploited in the wild-update to 10.6p2, harden SSH. View Article

KEV additions (selection): Ivanti Connect Secure; SonicWall SSLVPN; WordPress core; PHP RCEs; Collabora CODE; Apple CVE-2024-27834-prioritize remediation and compromise assessment. Ivanti KEV SonicWall KEV

outlook72h: - Execute immediate exposure sweep: identify and block Internet access to refrigeration controllers, PLCs, and OT gateways; enforce VPN+MFA for any required remote access. - Patch cycle 1: NetScaler ADC/Gateway, OpenSSH (10.6p2), Ivanti/SonicWall KEVs; rotate credentials/tokens and inspect for persistence. - Patch cycle 2 (staged in test): Advantech gateways (EKI/WISE-6610), OPC UA/Milo stacks, Danfoss iC7 (coordinate change control). - Monitoring uplift: enable protocol-aware detection for S7comm/OPC UA; add rules for refrigeration setpoint/defrost changes and abnormal controller cycles. - Threat hunts: VPN logs for anomalous sources; Zimbra logs for SOAP/GAL exfil/app passwords; switch/router configs for tampering (Zyxel/Cisco). - Brief operations on elevated risk; pre-authorize emergency maintenance windows for critical OT updates if required for safety.
